description_en: Creates a route target group instance
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-route-target-group --vpc-id vpc-xxxx --route-target-member-list MemberId=ep-xxxx MemberType=GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint Weight=100 --config-mode Active-Standby --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRouteTargetGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the route target group.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: route_target_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the route target group.
The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组的描述信息。
描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: route_target_group_description

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the route target group member
fields.name: member_id

fields.help_en:
The member type of the route target group.

Supported type:

GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint

In active/standby mode, all members of the route target group must be of the same type
fields.help_zh:
路由目标组的成员类型。

当前支持的类型：

GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint

主备模式下，路由目标组所有成员的类型必须相同
fields.name: member_type

fields.help_en:
The weight of the route target group member. Valid values:

100: The member is the primary instance.
0: The member is the secondary instance.

The weight can only be set during creation and cannot be modified
fields.help_zh:
路由目标组成员的权重值。取值：

100：表示成员为主实例。
0：表示成员为备实例。

权重值仅支持在创建时设置，不支持修改
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en:
The member list of the route target group.

In active/standby mode, the following limits apply to route target group members:

The number of route target group members must be 2.
The route target group members must be in different zones
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组的成员列表。

主备模式下，对路由目标组成员有如下限制：

路由目标组成员数量必须为2
路由目标组成员必须属于不同可用区
parameters.name: route_target_member_list

parameters.help_en:
The configuration mode of the route target group. Valid values:

Active-Standby: active/standby mode
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组的配置模式，支持模式如下：

Active-Standby: 主备模式
parameters.name: config_mode

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the route target group. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 路由目标组所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

RouteTargetGroupId.description_en: The instance ID of the route target group
